**New here:** run, hop, variable-height jump, kick, the tell (tail-tip wiggle), squeeze (hold Up).

## Main path (Jump 2 / Speed 2: steps <= 2 tiles up, gaps <= 3 tiles)

1. Three story panels (open-1..3.webp, captions in TEXT.opening.panels), then control starts in the cup.
2. tank-cup: dodge the tongs 3 times, then a held jump onto the rim (beats 1-2).
3. tank-sand: the no-fail chase, the tell is taught here (beat 3).
4. tank-decor: climb; kick the pebble off a ledge to make a step (beat 4).
5. tank-lid: squeeze through the lid gap; the cup tips (beats 5-6) -> panel open-4 -> bed-carrier, first Chirp prompt (Stripe answers), Pip's vow (TEXT.opening.pipVow).

## Notes

- These rooms sit off the house map at y 18-20 and are never revisited (the map hides zone z00).
- No damage anywhere in the tank: Duchess's lunges are scripted misses; falls just reset to the last ground.
- Recorded solution: design/solutions/opening.json (tools/solutions/opening.mjs).
- Music: title (slowed, per the design). Palette and paintings: bg/z00-tank.
- Props: tongs, feeder-cup, feeder-cup-tipped, hide-log, fake-plant, water-dish, pebble, pebble-chip, mesh-lid, sand-berm.

### tank-cup: In the Cup

Cell 0,20, 1x1 screens (32x18 tiles). Purpose: start, tutorial.

Beat 1-2. Pip starts inside the feeder cup on Duchess's rock. The tongs dip three times (left, right, middle): hop left and right to dodge (teaches move + jump). Then hold Jump for a full-height leap onto the cup rim (cup wall 2.5 tiles: only a held jump clears it) and drop to the sand on the right.

- signs: TEXT.signs.move, TEXT.signs.jumpHold
- props: feeder-cup, tongs

Exits:
- right -> **tank-sand** (z00-tank, builder A) at cell 0,20 right of tank-cup, rows 12-15 (suggested); gate: open

### tank-sand: The Sand

Cell 1,20, 2x1 screens (64x18 tiles). Purpose: tutorial.

Beat 3: Duchess stirs. A no-fail chase across 2 screens of sand: she opens one eye, her tail tip wiggles with the rattle-swish (the tell, taught here: sign "When the tail tip wiggles, move!"), and she lunges slowly and misses into the sand berm. Low hops over sand ripples; nothing can hurt you here.

- signs: TEXT.signs.tell
- props: sand-berm, water-dish, hide-log

Exits:
- left -> **tank-cup** (z00-tank, builder A) at cell 0,20 right of tank-cup, rows 12-15 (suggested); gate: open
- right -> **tank-decor** (z00-tank, builder A) at cell 2,20 right of tank-sand, rows 12-15 (suggested); gate: open

### tank-decor: The Decor

Cell 3,19, 1x2 screens (32x36 tiles). Purpose: tutorial.

Beat 4: climb the decor, 2 screens tall: hide log, fake plant leaves (one-way), the water-dish rim. One ledge is 1 tile too high: a loose pebble sits on the ledge above; kick it off so it lands as a step (teaches kick). The kick target is a scripted prop (pebble) that becomes a solid tile when it lands.

- signs: TEXT.signs.kick
- props: hide-log, fake-plant, water-dish, pebble, pebble-chip

Exits:
- left -> **tank-sand** (z00-tank, builder A) at cell 2,20 right of tank-sand, rows 12-15 (suggested); gate: open
- top -> **tank-lid** (z00-tank, builder A) at cell 3,19 top of tank-decor, cols 12-19 (suggested); gate: open

### tank-lid: The Lid Gap

Cell 3,18, 1x1 screens (32x18 tiles). Purpose: tutorial.

Beat 5-6: the mesh lid is ajar. Squeeze through the 1-tile gap (hold Up: sign). Pip's leap off the rim knocks the feeder cup off the tank (scripted), then story panel 4 (open-4.webp) and the Bedroom begins in bed-carrier with the first Chirp prompt.

- signs: TEXT.signs.squeeze
- props: mesh-lid, feeder-cup-tipped

Exits:
- bottom -> **tank-decor** (z00-tank, builder A) at cell 3,19 top of tank-decor, cols 12-19 (suggested); gate: open
